symbols.name: frame
symbols.meaning: The invertible linear operator on arrays attached to vertex $v$ of a network, so that the stored array at $v$ is $D_v g$.
symbols.quote: Then, at each source, gate and sink $v$, choose an invertible linear operator $D_v$ on these arrays.

symbols.name: logical array
symbols.meaning: The array a wire is meant to represent before any frame is applied.
symbols.quote: Here $g$ is the logical array, the array a wire is meant to represent before any frame is applied.

symbols.name: pointwise gate
symbols.meaning: A fixed linear map that combines the entries of several wires at each address.
symbols.quote: Write $G$ for a pointwise linear gate, which combines the entries of several wires at each address.
